For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Western Atlantic:
An area of low pressure is expected to form along a weakening 
frontal boundary a few hundred miles northeast of the Bahamas in a 
day or so. This system could acquire some subtropical 
characteristics late this week while it drifts over the western 
Atlantic. The chances of subtropical development should end by the 
weekend when the system is expected to move eastward or 
northeastward into unfavorable environmental conditions.
